title: Audit and Refine Production UI/UX
objective: Audit and refine EduAI's production UI across public, student, instructor, and administrator route families with a unified design system, compact course cards, restrained visual hierarchy, mobile-first layouts, accessible controls, and browser-verified responsive behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Major route families are inventoried and audited against production at representative mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
Design tokens, typography, buttons, inputs, cards, containers, spacing, focus, motion, loading, empty, error, modal, and notification patterns are coherent and reusable.
Homepage and course discovery share a compact, balanced CourseCard system that handles long Vietnamese content without overflow.
Course detail, learning, dashboards, forms, tables, navigation, and notification surfaces remain usable and readable on mobile without desktop regressions.
Mobile fixed navigation and notifications respect safe areas and do not cover primary content or actions.
Frontend tests, build, browser console, responsive visual review, basic accessibility checks, deployment, and production UAT pass with sanitized evidence.
verification: Run focused component/unit tests, the full frontend test suite, production build, and bundle budget.
Run browser QA at the document's mobile, tablet, and desktop viewport matrix for all accessible major routes and representative authenticated role surfaces.
Capture before/after screenshots for homepage, courses, course detail, learning, dashboards, navigation, and notification behavior where accessible.
Verify console errors, horizontal overflow, keyboard focus, semantic headings, touch targets, long Vietnamese content, fixed/sticky collisions, and reduced-motion behavior.
Deploy through the existing frontend workflow and repeat bounded production UAT before marking DONE.

title: Define Commerce, Membership, Payment, and Access Contracts
objective: Define the Phase 3 domain boundaries, state machines, money representation, snapshots, ownership rules, and provider interfaces before persistence or UI work.
acceptanceCriteria: An accepted ADR defines cart, order, payment, refund, membership, entitlement, course-access, analytics, and affiliate boundaries.
Order/payment state transitions, immutable snapshots, minor-unit VND handling, idempotency keys, and audit ownership are explicit.
Stored-value wallets, recurring billing, automatic payouts, proration, and browser-authoritative payment success are explicitly excluded.
verification: Review contracts against existing course, enrollment, voucher, scholarship, TMI, audit, notification, and authorization behavior.
Run AI-DOS validation and obtain human approval of the ADR before schema work.

extensions.testStrategy: Contract and dependency review.

title: Add Product, Cart, Order, and Payment Persistence
objective: Add production-safe persistence for sellable products, carts, immutable order lines, payments, refunds, and lifecycle history.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema and migration preserve course price compatibility and model monetary values in integer minor units with currency.
Order lines snapshot product identity, display name, unit price, discount, quantity, and final amount independently of later catalog edits.
Unique provider references, append-only lifecycle history, ownership indexes, and non-destructive archival constraints exist.
verification: Validate Prisma schema and migration SQL, including rollback/recovery impact.
Run persistence tests for constraints, ownership, duplicate references, totals, and archival.

extensions.testStrategy: Schema, migration, constraint, and transaction tests.
extensions.securityConsiderations: Financial history is append-only and user scoped.

title: Deliver Learner Cart, Pricing, and Order Creation
objective: Allow learners to manage a course cart and create one pending order using server-authoritative prices and existing voucher rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Cart endpoints and UI add, remove, list, and clear eligible course items without accepting client-calculated totals.
Checkout revalidates publication, moderation, ownership, currency, voucher eligibility, and price before creating one immutable pending order.
Already-owned courses are rejected and courses available through membership show a clear perpetual-purchase warning rather than being silently blocked.
verification: Run pricing, voucher, stale-cart, duplicate-item, ownership, concurrent-checkout, and authorization tests.
Run affected builds and browser-check cart totals, errors, empty state, and mobile checkout.

extensions.testStrategy: Unit, API, component, and browser checkout tests.

title: Deliver Administrator Commerce Catalog and Order Operations
objective: Give platform administrators controlled visibility and configuration for sellable courses, orders, payments, and lifecycle history.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can manage sellability and prices without mutating historical order snapshots.
Paginated order detail and history expose safe financial metadata, owner, totals, payment status, and fulfillment status.
All mutations are administrator-only, validated, audited, and cannot rewrite paid transaction history.
verification: Run role-matrix, pagination, filter, immutable-history, audit, and concurrent-update tests.
Verify responsive admin catalog/order flows and no sensitive provider credentials in responses.

extensions.securityConsiderations: Platform administrator only; sanitize payment metadata.

title: Verify Commerce Boundaries, Concurrency, and Regression
objective: Close the commerce-foundation gate before memberships or PayOS depend on it.
acceptanceCriteria: Pricing, totals, snapshots, ownership, duplicate checkout, state transitions, and audit invariants pass under concurrent requests.
Existing course enrollment, voucher, scholarship, TMI, certificate, notification, and role flows remain compatible.
Migration, builds, focused suites, deployment, and bounded production read/write UAT have sanitized evidence.
verification: Run backend/frontend focused and regression suites plus migration validation.
Run authorized cross-role production UAT and reconcile dedicated test orders without retaining sensitive data.

title: Add Versioned Membership Plans and Dynamic Durations
objective: Model publishable plan versions and administrator-defined duration/price options without hard-coded tier names, durations, or discount caps.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can define plan names such as Silver, Gold, and Diamond while the domain supports additional plans without code changes.
Each version supports administrator-created positive whole-month durations, price or discount configuration, display order, activation windows, and archival.
Published versions and duration prices referenced by orders are immutable; new edits create new versions and discounts may range from zero through 100 percent.
verification: Run versioning, dynamic-duration, calendar-month expiry, discount, zero-price, archive, and immutable-reference tests.
Validate migration, currency/minor-unit constraints, indexes, and compatibility with order snapshots.

title: Add Configurable Service Entitlements and Usage Quotas
objective: Represent membership service benefits as stable entitlement codes with boolean, metered, or unlimited values.
acceptanceCriteria: Entitlement definitions have stable codes, typed value semantics, reset periods, and safe display metadata.
Plan versions configure services and quotas without branching business logic on Silver, Gold, or Diamond names.
Usage consumption is atomic, idempotent, user scoped, observable, and rejects exhausted or expired entitlement access.
verification: Run boolean, quota, unlimited, reset-boundary, concurrent-consumption, expiry, and authorization tests.
Verify existing AI, mentor, resource, and certificate services can adopt the resolver incrementally.

extensions.securityConsiderations: Quota consumption must be atomic and self scoped.

title: Add Included-Course Mappings and Centralized Access Grants
objective: Separate learning enrollment from authorization and centralize free, purchase, membership, grace, scholarship, and administrator course access.
acceptanceCriteria: Plan versions map explicitly to included courses and course inclusion changes do not mutate prior paid versions.
CourseAccessService resolves free, perpetual purchase, active membership, grace, scholarship, and admin grants consistently.
Lessons, quizzes, assignments, classrooms, certificates, progress, and course-grounded AI use the centralized decision without deleting progress on expiry.
verification: Run source precedence, expiry, concurrent grants, ownership, moderation, and cross-module access tests.
Run regression for enrollment, progress, completion, certificate issuance, and private AI/course content.

extensions.securityConsiderations: One centralized deny-by-default access resolver.

title: Deliver Membership Administration
objective: Allow platform administrators to draft, preview, publish, archive, and version plans, duration prices, services, quotas, included courses, and grace policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can configure arbitrary plans and whole-month durations, prices, discounts, services, quotas, courses, activation windows, and display order.
Publishing creates an immutable version with a clear diff and high-discount warning that does not impose an artificial cap.
Existing subscribers and historical orders show their referenced version and cannot be silently rewritten.
verification: Run admin role, validation, publish concurrency, immutable-version, audit, pagination, and search tests.
Browser-check plan editor, comparison, long Vietnamese content, mobile layout, warnings, and destructive confirmations.

title: Deliver Learner Membership Catalog, Renewal, and Plan Change
objective: Let learners compare current plan benefits, select an administrator-defined duration, create membership orders, renew, upgrade, or schedule downgrade.
acceptanceCriteria: Catalog compares published versions, services, quotas, included courses, dynamic durations, base price, discount, and final price from live APIs.
Same-plan renewal extends from current expiry when active and from payment time when expired; there is no automatic recurring charge.
MVP upgrades activate after payment without proration, downgrades schedule for expiry, and checkout requires explicit confirmation of changed benefits.
verification: Run renewal boundary, leap/calendar month, expired, upgrade, downgrade, concurrency, ownership, and snapshot tests.
Run responsive browser journeys for compare, checkout, current plan, pending change, expiry, and errors.

title: Preserve Removed-Course Learning Continuity
objective: Apply explicit removal modes and bounded grace access when a learner renews into a plan version that no longer includes an in-progress course.
acceptanceCriteria: Normal removal preserves access through the paid term and optionally creates a configurable bounded MEMBERSHIP_GRACE grant only for courses started before removal.
Renewal clearly adopts the latest plan version and discloses removed courses and grace expiry before purchase.
Immediate legal/security revocation is separately authorized and audited; all modes preserve progress and earned certificates.
verification: Run started/not-started, continuous/lapsed renewal, zero/custom grace, completion during grace, purchase override, and emergency revocation tests.
Verify learner notices before renewal and near grace expiry plus administrator audit history.

title: Verify Membership Lifecycle, Authorization, and Production UX
objective: Close the membership gate with financial snapshots, entitlement, course-access, versioning, and cross-role evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Plan version, duration, pricing, renewal, plan change, quotas, course access, grace, expiry, and progress-preservation matrices pass.
Admin, learner, instructor, anonymous, and suspended-user boundaries are verified across all affected modules.
Migrations, builds, regression, deployment, notification behavior, responsive UX, and production UAT pass with sanitized evidence.
verification: Run backend/frontend focused suites, full affected regression, schema validation, and browser role matrix.
Deploy and execute authorized production membership UAT using dedicated records and verified cleanup.

title: Add Payment-Provider Boundary and Secure PayOS Configuration
objective: Introduce a provider-neutral payment contract with PayOS as the only initial implementation and secrets outside source control.
acceptanceCriteria: PaymentProvider exposes create, retrieve, cancel, verify-webhook, and reconcile operations without leaking PayOS types into commerce services.
Client ID, API key, checksum key, URLs, timeout, and environment mode are validated at startup and never returned or logged.
Provider responses are schema validated as untrusted external input with explicit timeout and failure mapping.
verification: Run configuration, missing-secret, malformed-response, timeout, error-mapping, and log-sanitization tests.
Review environment examples, deployment secret requirements, API boundaries, and rollback configuration.

extensions.securityConsiderations: Treat provider data as untrusted and keep all credentials secret.

title: Create PayOS Payment Requests and Learner QR Checkout
objective: Create expiring PayOS payment requests for course and membership orders and present a safe QR checkout experience.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend creates one active PayOS request per payable order using unique orderCode, authoritative amount, bounded description, return URL, cancel URL, and expiry.
Learner sees QR, amount, order reference, expiry, pending status, retry guidance, and polling/SSE updates without frontend-generated payment facts.
Free orders bypass PayOS through an explicit audited zero-payment fulfillment path.
verification: Run duplicate-request, stale-order, amount, expiry, provider failure, authorization, and zero-order tests.
Browser-check QR checkout at mobile/desktop sizes and confirm return/cancel URLs never mark payment paid.

title: Verify and Ingest Idempotent PayOS Webhooks
objective: Make verified PayOS webhook data the authoritative external settlement signal and handle retries safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Webhook verifies the PayOS signature over the raw contract before any lookup or state mutation and rejects malformed or unsigned payloads.
Provider reference, orderCode, amount, currency, account/channel, and eligible state match before recording payment.
Duplicate, reordered, concurrent, and manually replayed deliveries produce at most one financial transition and return stable responses.
verification: Run official sample, invalid-signature, altered-field, unknown-order, amount-mismatch, duplicate, concurrent, late, and replay tests.
Verify sanitized structured logs, audit events, rate limits, and provider retry-compatible HTTP responses.

extensions.securityConsiderations: Signature verification and idempotency precede all financial mutation.

title: Fulfill Course and Membership Orders Atomically
objective: Translate one authoritative paid order into perpetual course grants or time-bounded membership rights exactly once.
acceptanceCriteria: Payment record, PAID transition, course grants or subscription activation, fulfillment record, history, audit, and outbox notification commit atomically.
Course purchases create perpetual PURCHASE grants; memberships reference the purchased plan version and calendar-month duration snapshot.
Webhook retries, partial failures, existing grants, renewal, upgrade, and free-order paths cannot duplicate access or subscription time.
verification: Run transaction rollback, retry, concurrency, mixed-cart, grant precedence, renewal, plan change, and outbox tests.
Verify paid-but-not-fulfilled recovery without fabricating a second payment.

extensions.securityConsiderations: Atomic exactly-once financial effects over at-least-once webhooks.

title: Reconcile Pending Payments and Expose Payment Review
objective: Recover missed callbacks and provide auditable administrator review for unmatched or inconsistent payment events.
acceptanceCriteria: Bounded reconciliation queries eligible pending/review orders through PaymentProvider with rate limits, checkpoints, and idempotent updates.
Unknown code, mismatched amount, late payment, duplicate payment, provider outage, and paid-not-fulfilled cases enter explicit review reasons.
Admin can inspect and resolve review cases through authorized audited actions without rewriting provider transactions.
verification: Run missed-webhook, rate-limit, timeout, pagination, restart, duplicate, mismatch, late, and recovery tests.
Verify admin role matrix, sanitized details, resolution audit, alerts, and operational runbook.

title: Handle Payment Expiry, Cancellation, and Audited Manual Refunds
objective: Complete non-success payment lifecycles without automatic outgoing-money execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Pending payment requests expire or cancel idempotently and late settlement moves to review instead of being discarded.
Admin records a manual refund reference, amount, reason, approver, timestamp, and access consequence without deleting original payment history.
Refund policy revokes or shortens applicable unconsumed rights explicitly while preserving learning history, certificates, disputes, and audit.
verification: Run expiry race, cancellation race, late payment, partial/full refund record, duplicate refund, access consequence, and audit tests.
Browser-check learner statuses and administrator confirmation/review flows.

extensions.securityConsiderations: No automatic payout; refund records require authorized review.

title: Verify PayOS Security, Failure Recovery, and Production UAT
objective: Close the settlement gate with sandbox, failure-injection, deployment, reconciliation, and bounded production evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Signature, amount, identity, replay, concurrency, secret handling, rate limit, timeout, and authorization matrices pass.
Course and membership QR payments, webhook fulfillment, missed-webhook reconciliation, cancellation, expiry, and review flows pass in supported environments.
Builds, migrations, regression, deployment, rollback, monitoring, and authorized production UAT have sanitized structured evidence.
verification: Run PayOS test-mode end-to-end scenarios and targeted security/failure tests before live work.
Perform separately authorized bounded live payment UAT, reconcile the exact transaction, and record no credentials or raw sensitive payloads.

extensions.securityConsiderations: Live monetary UAT requires separate explicit authorization.

title: Define Authoritative Commerce Analytics Metrics and Privacy Rules
objective: Define metric formulas, time boundaries, currencies, dimensions, attribution, exclusions, and privacy before building dashboards.
acceptanceCriteria: Definitions cover gross/net revenue, paid/refunded orders, average order value, MRR, renewal, expiry, churn, conversion, voucher impact, and entitlement usage.
Each metric names its authoritative tables, timestamp, timezone, filters, refund treatment, and reconciliation tolerance.
Role, aggregation, retention, export, and personally identifiable information boundaries are documented and approved.
verification: Reconcile example calculations against known order/payment/subscription fixtures.
Review definitions with commerce, membership, security, and product contracts and run AI-DOS validation.

title: Deliver Revenue, Order, Payment, and Refund Analytics
objective: Provide administrator revenue and settlement reporting that reconciles with authoritative financial records.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard reports gross/net revenue, order/payment/refund counts, average order value, status breakdown, and trends over validated date ranges.
Filters support product type, course, membership plan/version, duration, payment status, and currency without unbounded queries.
Totals reconcile to fixture and production aggregate checks and expose freshness/timezone metadata.
verification: Run formula, timezone, refund, empty-data, pagination, filter, authorization, and query-bound tests.
Browser-check charts/tables at mobile and desktop sizes plus sanitized production aggregates.

title: Deliver Membership MRR, Renewal, Expiry, and Churn Analytics
objective: Measure membership revenue and lifecycle behavior across plans, versions, and administrator-defined durations.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard reports active subscriptions, normalized MRR, new, renewed, upgraded, downgraded, expired, and churned cohorts using documented formulas.
Metrics distinguish paid term value from cash collection and handle free, 100-percent-discount, refund, grace, and scheduled-change cases.
Plan/version/duration filters and cohort comparisons remain bounded and privacy safe.
verification: Run cohort, calendar-month, renewal, lapse, upgrade, downgrade, refund, free-plan, and timezone fixture tests.
Reconcile dashboard aggregates with authoritative subscription and payment records.

title: Deliver Product, Voucher, Checkout, and Entitlement Usage Analytics
objective: Explain product performance, checkout completion, promotion impact, and whether membership services are actually used.
acceptanceCriteria: Reports cover product/course sales, cart-to-order and order-to-paid conversion, abandonment, voucher discount/revenue impact, and plan-duration mix.
Entitlement usage reports aggregate quota consumption, saturation, and unused benefits without exposing private learner activity.
Event deduplication, bot/internal traffic exclusion, and attribution windows are documented and enforced.
verification: Run funnel, duplicate-event, voucher, mixed-product, entitlement-reset, privacy-threshold, and filter tests.
Verify aggregates against deterministic fixtures and responsive admin visualizations.

title: Add Exports and Verify Analytics Accuracy, Access, and Performance
objective: Close the analytics gate with safe exports, reconciliation, query budgets, access controls, and production verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Authorized administrators can export bounded CSV reports using the same filters/formulas as dashboards with injection-safe cells and audit events.
Metric fixtures and sampled production aggregates reconcile within documented tolerance and discrepancies are observable.
Role boundaries, privacy thresholds, query budgets, caching/freshness, builds, deployment, and UAT pass.
verification: Run export injection, authorization, reconciliation, load/query-plan, cache, timezone, and large-range tests.
Run responsive production dashboard UAT and retain aggregate evidence only.

title: Define Affiliate Policy, Identities, and Immutable Financial Records
objective: Define eligible products, attribution windows, commission bases, statuses, reversals, approval, withdrawal, ownership, and immutable ledger boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Policy defines first/last-touch choice, cookie/code precedence, self-referral, existing-user behavior, attribution window, eligible products, and refund reversal.
Schema models affiliates, referral identities, attributed orders, commission ledger entries, balances, and withdrawal requests without storing a cash wallet.
Commission rates and policies are versioned and order attribution snapshots remain immutable.
verification: Review policy against order, payment, refund, privacy, audit, and analytics contracts.
Validate schema/migration, uniqueness, financial conservation, ownership, and rollback tests.

title: Attribute Eligible Orders to Referral Links and Codes
objective: Capture consent-aware referral identity and attach one eligible attribution snapshot to an order before payment.
acceptanceCriteria: Affiliate links/codes resolve only active affiliates and apply the documented attribution window and precedence.
Self-referral, tampered code, duplicate attribution, internal/admin traffic, and ineligible products are rejected or excluded explicitly.
Attribution is finalized on order creation, cannot move after payment, and does not expose private buyer information to affiliates.
verification: Run window, precedence, self-referral, invalid code, duplicate, device/session, ownership, privacy, and concurrent-order tests.
Browser-check link landing, attribution disclosure, checkout continuity, and consent behavior.

title: Calculate Pending, Approved, Reversed, and Payable Commissions
objective: Create exactly-once commission ledger effects from authoritative fulfillment and refund events.
acceptanceCriteria: Eligible fulfilled orders create one pending commission from the versioned policy and snapshotted commission base.
Approval delay, refund/cancellation reversal, manual adjustment, payable balance, and withdrawal reservation preserve ledger conservation.
Duplicate events, partial refunds, concurrent approval/withdrawal, and negative-balance cases are deterministic and audited.
verification: Run exactly-once, rounding, approval, refund, partial refund, reversal, adjustment, concurrency, and conservation tests.
Reconcile commission totals to eligible paid-order fixtures and analytics definitions.

extensions.securityConsiderations: Append-only financial ledger with exactly-once event processing.

title: Deliver Administrator Affiliate and Commission Operations
objective: Allow administrators to approve affiliates, version commission policies, inspect attribution/ledger history, and resolve exceptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can approve, suspend, archive, and inspect affiliates without deleting financial history.
Commission policy changes are versioned and affect only newly attributed eligible orders.
Paginated attribution, commission, adjustment, and withdrawal views are authorized, audited, searchable, and privacy safe.
verification: Run role, approval, suspension, versioning, adjustment, pagination, privacy, audit, and concurrent-update tests.
Browser-check administrator tables, filters, detail history, warnings, and mobile behavior.

title: Deliver Affiliate Dashboard and Manual Withdrawal Requests
objective: Give approved affiliates privacy-safe performance reporting and an audited request workflow for manually paid withdrawals.
acceptanceCriteria: Affiliate sees own clicks/attributions, pending/approved/reversed/payable commissions, withdrawal history, policy, and freshness metadata without buyer identity.
Withdrawal requests validate minimum, available balance, payout profile, duplicate/concurrent requests, and reserve payable commission atomically.
Admin records external payout reference and decision manually; EduAI does not initiate automated money transfer.
verification: Run ownership, privacy, balance reservation, minimum, duplicate, concurrent, approve/reject/paid, and reversal tests.
Browser-check affiliate and admin workflows, empty/error states, responsive layout, and notifications.

extensions.securityConsiderations: No automated payout; reserve balances atomically and hide buyer identity.

title: Verify Affiliate Abuse Controls, Financial Invariants, and UAT
objective: Close the affiliate gate with fraud-resistance, ledger reconciliation, privacy, role, deployment, and production evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Self-referral, code stuffing, duplicate attribution, replay, refund abuse, concurrent withdrawal, suspension, and privilege matrices pass.
Order attribution, commission ledger, payable balance, reservations, withdrawals, refunds, and analytics reconcile exactly.
Builds, migrations, regression, deployment, privacy review, monitoring, and bounded production UAT pass with sanitized evidence.
verification: Run security, concurrency, property/invariant, reconciliation, privacy, and cross-role browser suites.
Deploy and perform read-only plus separately authorized dedicated production UAT without automated payout.

title: Audit Migrations, Settlement, Access, and Accounting Invariants
objective: Establish a reconciled Phase 3 release candidate before cross-role production journeys.
acceptanceCriteria: All Phase 3 migrations apply from the production baseline and have explicit recovery/rollback classification with no failed migration state.
Orders equal payment/refund/fulfillment effects and affiliate commission/withdrawal effects within documented invariants.
Course purchase, membership, grace, scholarship, admin grants, progress, certificates, and service quota access matrices reconcile.
verification: Run clean/staged migration rehearsals, database constraints, financial reconciliation, and access invariant suites.
Review indexes, query plans, retention, backup/recovery, audit history, and sanitized release evidence.

title: Run Cross-Role Commerce and Membership End-to-End UAT
objective: Verify complete learner, administrator, instructor, and affiliate journeys against the release candidate.
acceptanceCriteria: Learner course cart/purchase, membership purchase/renewal/plan change, access, grace, expiry, notifications, and history journeys pass.
Admin catalog, plan version, entitlement, order/payment review, refund record, analytics, affiliate, and withdrawal review journeys pass.
Instructor content ownership and anonymous/suspended/lower-role denial remain correct with no cross-user data disclosure.
verification: Run deterministic local/staging E2E across supported roles and mobile/desktop viewports.
Run bounded production UAT with dedicated records, explicit monetary authorization where needed, cleanup, and sanitized evidence.

title: Verify Security, Observability, Accessibility, and Performance
objective: Prove Phase 3 is operable and safe under payment, financial, authorization, failure, and user-interface load.
acceptanceCriteria: Threat review covers PayOS signatures/secrets, replay, IDOR, price tampering, webhook abuse, refunds, affiliate fraud, exports, and sensitive logs.
Health, correlation, alerts, payment/reconciliation/fulfillment lag, mismatch, failure, and financial discrepancy metrics support operations without sensitive payloads.
Checkout/admin/analytics/affiliate accessibility, query/API budgets, bundle budgets, and representative production performance pass or have accepted remediation.
verification: Run endpoint audit, dependency/security checks, load/failure tests, accessibility browser checks, and performance measurements.
Trigger sanitized synthetic failure alerts and verify runbooks, dashboards, rollback signals, and no secret leakage.

title: Deploy, Verify, and Close the Phase 3 Release
objective: Deploy the approved Phase 3 release through normal workflows, verify rollback and production behavior, and close only with complete evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Release checklist, migration order, PayOS production configuration, feature flags, monitoring, support, reconciliation, backup, and rollback steps are approved.
Backend/frontend deployment, migration, smoke, cross-role UAT, payment settlement, fulfillment, analytics, affiliate, observability, and rollback verification pass.
Canonical AI-DOS state, roadmap, evidence, manual actions, handoff, known limitations, and production revision references are complete and sanitized.
verification: Execute the approved staged deployment and rollback rehearsal through repository workflows.
Repeat production health, payment, access, analytics, affiliate, responsive, and support-readiness checks before marking Phase 3 complete.

extensions.securityConsiderations: Live monetary verification and rollback follow separate approved operational steps.
